subject: Vendor ecosystem snapshot for SIG follow-up
messages:
From: Leah Turner <security@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up — full list of subprocessors / telemetry endpoints

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of Acme's SIG review we need a complete export of Redwood's third-party ecosystem focused on anything that stores, processes, or transmits customer data for our account: cloud providers, telemetry/observability, error reporting, support/CRM, backups, analytics, and any vendor that receives logs or traces.

Could you send: 1) a CSV listing vendor name, purpose, region where data is processed, data types shared (PII, logs, telemetry), contract/SLA status, and SOC2 or other attestation; and 2) links to evidence (SOC reports, DPA, penetration test summaries) where available.

I attached a short list of SIG follow-up questions to help prioritize. We need an initial export by Monday to align with our legal review. If parts of this are sensitive, please flag them and we can use an NDAs/secure transfer.

Best,
Leah Turner
Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics

Attachment: Acme_SIG_questions.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Turner <security@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — full list of subprocessors / telemetry endpoints

Hi Leah — thanks for the clear ask and the sample questions. We'll take point on the CSV and evidence links. Quick notes:

- We can provide a CSV with the columns you listed.
- For telemetry/observability, do you want both internal-only tools (e.g., runtime traces we retain) and vendor-hosted services (e.g., Sentry, Datadog)? We typically include both in SIG responses but want to confirm your scope.
- There are a few legacy vendors where contracts are managed by Finance; I cc'd Priyom to help surface those.
- We should be able to deliver an initial export by MON 2026-07-13 17:00 PT. If you need earlier, let us know which items are highest priority.

Karthik and Neha: can you start pulling the inventory and evidence links? I will coordinate collating into one CSV and upload to a shared Drive. Karthik — if you need a template, I can share one in a follow-up.

Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Rachel — replying inline and copying status.

> For telemetry/observability, do you want both internal-only tools and vendor-hosted services?
We should include any vendor-hosted services that receive customer-identifiable logs or traces (Sentry, Datadog, Honeycomb). Internal, self-hosted components that never leave our VPC can be marked as "internal" with a note about retention.

Status: I pulled data from the infra inventory (GCP projects + IAM roles) and started a mapping to vendor categories. Neha — can you pull contract status and SOC2 evidence for the following list: Datadog, Sentry, Segment, Zendesk, AWS (S3/RDS), Google Cloud Logging, PagerDuty. Priyom — finance will need to confirm contracts for legacy backup vendor "SafeKeep" and our CDN partner.

I will draft the CSV template and push to Drive by EOD. Rachel — if you can confirm the exact column order for Acme's ingestion, I'll match it.

Thanks — Karthik

- Total vendors listed: 42 (cloud infra, telemetry, support, analytics, backups, CDN, mailing).
- Vendors with SOC2 on file: 28 (links in evidence file).
- Vendors processing customer-identifiable logs/traces: Datadog, Sentry, Segment, AWS CloudWatch (retained for up to 30 days; account-level logs only).
- Legacy backup vendor SafeKeep: contract in review — Priyom is coordinating remedial paperwork with Procurement.

Files attached: vendor-map-20260712.csv (CSV), vendor-evidence-links.txt (plain text with links and evidence notes). If you'd prefer we upload the SOC2 packages to a secure portal, we can do that.

Next steps: Leah — please confirm if Acme needs encrypted transfer for full SOC packages or if secure Drive links are sufficient. We can also redact internal IP addresses if required.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
